input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a stipulated, Company-payable early-termination amount: 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, triggered by any Company termination, including ordinary 90-day non-renewal under Section 4.1. Because our fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month, this formula routinely exceeds a year's fees (e.g., at $5M Net Sales the payment is ~$2.1M against ~$1.46M of annual fees), so it fails the fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees and is not excluded where we terminate for HDI's non-performance. Given HDI builds and hosts the Site at no upfront cost, we proposed the fallback rather than outright deletion: cap the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees and disapply it where we terminate under Section 1.6 or for HDI's breach.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company-payable Termination Payment at three months' fees and exclude termination for HDI's breach
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a termination payment measured as half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales, which can far exceed the fees we pay HDI and is triggered even by ordinary non-renewal. Our position is no liquidated amounts payable by the Company; as a fallback we have capped the Termination Payment at three months' fees and confirmed none is due where we terminate for HDI's failure to perform.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the lesser of (i) the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, and (ii) the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3.1 in respect of the three (3) calendar months preceding the Termination Date. No Termination Payment shall be due if the Company terminates this Agreement pursuant to Section 1.6 or as a result of HDI's breach of this Agreement, and the Termination Payment shall be the only amount payable by the Company by reason of termination.
